note: MERGED by scripts/merge_work_surface_region.py from clearance surveys run 2026-08-15. Two changes from every earlier version of this file. (1) `clear_cells` is new: the cells that keep the 0.15 m wearer clearance floor as well as solving IK. The floor is NOT an IK constraint -- the SRDF excludes the wearer pairs a shoulder-mounted arm actually threatens, so collision-aware IK returns poses with the tube inside the person -- so it has to be measured separately and it never had been. (2) the box now runs to |x| = 1.00; the old |x| <= 0.70 was where the survey stopped looking, not where the arm stops.
